description: This file is a shell script used for testing behaviors related to 'git rev-list' with missing objects. It contains various test cases that set up git repositories, manipulate object files, and verify the output of commands to handle missing objects and references.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting a successful command execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the command to fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables.

methods.name: test_oid_to_path
methods.description: Converts a git object ID to its object path in .git/objects.
